paragraphs.zh: Abbildungsblatt. Die Seite traegt ausser der Kopfzeile "EP 2 045 236 A1" und der Seitenzahl "19" keinen Text. Sie zeigt ein einziges Spektrum in einem rechteckigen Achsenrahmen. Unter der x-Achse links steht in grosser Fettschrift die Beschriftung "Fig. 3", mittig darunter die Achsenbeschriftung "Wellenzahl cm-1". Die x-Achse laeuft von links nach rechts fallend und ist mit 3500, 3000, 2500, 2000, 1500, 1000 und 500 beschriftet; der Rahmen reicht links etwa bis 3500 und rechts deutlich unter 500 hinaus, schaetzungsweise bis etwa 100 cm-1 (kein Teilstrich unter 500 ist beschriftet). Die y-Achse traegt KEINE Beschriftung und KEINE Einheit; sie ist mit 0.00, 0.05, 0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.25, 0.30 und 0.35 in Dezimalpunkt-Schreibweise beziffert und reicht von 0.00 bis knapp ueber 0.35 (Rahmenoberkante etwa 0.37). Die Banden zeigen nach OBEN, es ist also kein nach unten aufgetragenes Transmissionsspektrum. Insgesamt sind grob 40 bis 50 unterscheidbare Banden zu erkennen, davon etwa zehn deutlich hervortretende. Ungefaehre Lagen der auffaelligsten Banden, nur grob aus dem Diagramm abgelesen und NICHT als Messwerte zu verwenden: eine sehr starke Doppel- bzw. Mehrfachbande knapp unterhalb 3000 cm-1, die hoechste Bande der Kurve nahe 1700 cm-1, eine weitere sehr starke Bande nahe 1600 cm-1, eine dichte Gruppe mittelstarker Banden zwischen etwa 1600 und 1300 cm-1, viele kleine Banden im Bereich etwa 1300 bis 400 cm-1 sowie eine deutliche Bande im niedrigen Wellenzahlbereich, ungefaehr zwischen 300 und 200 cm-1. Zwischen etwa 2400 und 1900 cm-1 liegt eine sichtbar verrauschte Zone ohne echte Banden. Am rechten Rand faellt die Kurve senkrecht auf 0 ab, was das Ende der Aufzeichnung ist. Die genauen Bandenlagen sind in Tabelle 1 bzw. Tabelle 2 gedruckt und werden dort entnommen.
paragraphs.en: Figure sheet. Apart from the running header "EP 2 045 236 A1" and the page number "19" the sheet carries no text. It shows a single spectrum inside a rectangular axis box. Below the x axis, at the left, the label "Fig. 3" is printed in large bold type, and centred beneath the axis is the axis caption "Wellenzahl cm-1" (wavenumber cm-1). The x axis descends from left to right and is ticked 3500, 3000, 2500, 2000, 1500, 1000 and 500; the box starts at about 3500 on the left and continues well past 500 on the right, approximately to about 100 cm-1 (no tick below 500 is labelled). The y axis carries NO title and NO unit; it is numbered 0.00, 0.05, 0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.25, 0.30 and 0.35 with a decimal point, running from 0.00 to just over 0.35 (top of the box about 0.37). The bands point UPWARD, so this is not a downward-plotted transmission trace. Roughly 40 to 50 distinguishable bands are visible, about ten of them clearly prominent. Approximate positions of the most conspicuous bands, read only coarsely off the plot and NOT to be used as measurements: a very strong two- or three-component band just below 3000 cm-1, the tallest band of the whole trace near 1700 cm-1, a second very strong band near 1600 cm-1, a dense group of medium bands between about 1600 and 1300 cm-1, many small bands from about 1300 down to about 400 cm-1, and one distinct band at low wavenumber, roughly between 300 and 200 cm-1. A visibly noisy stretch without real bands lies between about 2400 and 1900 cm-1. At the extreme right the trace drops vertically to 0, which is the end of the recording. The exact band positions are printed in Tabelle 1 and Tabelle 2 and are to be taken from there.
paragraphs.notes: The sheet DOES print a figure label and it reads verbatim "Fig. 3", not "Abbildung 3"; the description at [0018] uses the word Abbildung. Taking Fig. 3 as Abbildung 3, [0018] makes this the Raman spectrum of crystal modification III. Two features of the plot support Raman rather than infrared and were read off this page alone: the bands are plotted upward from a baseline near zero, and the abscissa continues well below 400 cm-1 to roughly 100 cm-1, which a mid-infrared transmission or ATR measurement does not normally reach. Against that, the ordinate is numbered 0.00 to 0.35, a range that would also suit an absorbance scale, and the y axis carries no printed title at all, so the measured quantity cannot be read off the sheet and the Raman reading remains an inference from the label plus [0018]. No peak position on this page was measured; all positions above are eyeball estimates from tick spacing and are marked approximate. The x tick labels use no decimal separator and the y tick labels use a decimal point, not the German decimal comma; both are recorded as printed. doc_part is set to "description" because the schema enum offers only front_page, claims and description and has no value for a drawings sheet; this page is in fact one of the figure sheets that follow the description.

discrepancies.what: The sheet labels the figure with the English abbreviation while the German description names the same series differently.
discrepancies.text_says: [0018] lists the six figures as Abbildung 1, 1a, 2, 2a, 3, 3a

doc_part_note: doc_part normalised to 'drawings' by the run owner after the V pass. The prompt's enum is front_page|claims|description and has no value for a figure sheet, so the six sheet agents split three and three between 'description' and 'drawings' on identical pages. Nothing validates this field (build_enriched.py:157 and make_visual_evidence.py:980 pass it through as a label), so the honest value is kept and made consistent rather than forced back into an enum that cannot express it. The agents' own reasoning is preserved in each file's notes.
